elements.literalObservation: A saturated cobalt field fills the entire mobile panel.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use the cobalt brand field as an opaque root surface; do not reproduce the gray Behance backdrop or device mockup.

elements.literalObservation: A large cream irregular COOL CAT'S wordmark occupies the upper portion.
elements.rebuildDirective: Render as an authorized vector/raster asset and expose the café name separately to accessibility.

elements.literalObservation: A cream monoline cat in sunglasses carries a takeaway drink and surfboard.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep the illustration decorative and scalable; do not decompose its strokes into accessibility elements.

elements.literalObservation: A handwritten line reads come for the Brew, Stay for the vibes.
elements.rebuildDirective: Reserve handwriting for brand accent copy and provide the same phrase as native accessible text.

elements.literalObservation: Two equal outlined capsule controls are labeled Bookings and Menu.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use two semantic buttons; assign filled versus outlined hierarchy once the repeat-use primary route is confirmed.

elements.literalObservation: The leading outline capsule is labeled Bookings.
elements.rebuildDirective: Label with an action verb such as Book a table where localization permits; include pressed, loading, and unavailable states.

elements.literalObservation: The trailing outline capsule is labeled Menu.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a 44-point minimum target and consider a filled treatment when Menu is the primary repeat-use route.

elements.literalObservation: A warm-cream first-run page contains illustration, copy, pagination, Skip, and Next.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep onboarding optional, finite, locally persisted, and absent on ordinary repeat launches.

elements.literalObservation: A large black monoline scene shows a cat riding a dog to reach a coffee machine.
elements.rebuildDirective: Scale the illustration before reducing functional text; hide decorative strokes from accessibility.

elements.literalObservation: One dark line and two pale dots indicate the first of three pages.
elements.rebuildDirective: Expose current page and total semantically; do not rely only on line/dot color differences.

elements.literalObservation: The heading reads Cool Cat's Club.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native heading text with Dynamic Type.

elements.literalObservation: A short sentence describes favourite coffee and bites in one place.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep to one or two lines at default size and allow wrapping at large text sizes.

elements.literalObservation: Skip appears as a blue text action at lower leading.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep Skip available on every page and preserve a 44-point target.

elements.literalObservation: Next appears inside a compact filled cobalt rounded control at lower trailing.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use a 44-point target, pressed state, and a final-page verb that enters the actual task.

elements.literalObservation: A warm-cream menu landing contains a seal, four rows, watermark, and bottom cobalt panel.
elements.rebuildDirective: Build as a vertical browse surface with separated curated and taxonomy sections.

elements.literalObservation: A circular cat seal with surrounding COOL CAT'S CLUB and BREWS BITES text is centered near the top.
elements.rebuildDirective: Render as a compact asset; provide one accessible brand label and hide decorative lettering if duplicated.

elements.literalObservation: Four outlined rounded rows form the main navigation list.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use full-row semantic buttons with 64–72 point minimum height and 16–20 point gaps.

elements.literalObservation: Recommended is paired with copy about choices by Sir Edward the third.
elements.rebuildDirective: Place under a Curated for you section rather than presenting it as a product taxonomy peer.

elements.literalObservation: Popular is paired with copy about an Instagram-friendly choice.
elements.rebuildDirective: Place with editorial collections and define the ranking/data source.

elements.literalObservation: Food is presented as a rounded row with supporting copy.
elements.rebuildDirective: Place under Browse the menu and navigate to a food product collection.

elements.literalObservation: Beverages is presented as a rounded row with coffee, tea, and kombucha copy.
elements.rebuildDirective: Place under Browse the menu and keep the edge doodle outside text and hit regions.

elements.literalObservation: A large very pale cat-head graphic sits behind the lower content.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep noninteractive, low contrast, and hidden from accessibility.

elements.literalObservation: A cobalt rounded panel reads Cool Cat's Curation and asks for the lead on making dishes with a twist.
elements.rebuildDirective: Do not implement until its destination and user outcome are defined; use an explicit action verb.

elements.literalObservation: A cream product page includes navigation, product information, variants, photo, note, and order CTA.
elements.rebuildDirective: Build as a scrollable product configuration with a safe-area anchored order action.

elements.literalObservation: A blue back arrow sits at upper leading.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native navigation semantics and at least a 44-point hit region.

elements.literalObservation: An outline heart sits at upper trailing.
elements.rebuildDirective: Implement selected and unselected states with non-color semantics and accessible value.

elements.literalObservation: The product title and one paragraph identify Vietnamese Cold Coffee.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use native title and body text, permit wrapping, and avoid baking copy into the image.

elements.literalObservation: Small, Medium, and Large rows show volume, calories, price, and quantity controls.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use adaptive rows that reflow metadata beneath the variant name at large text sizes.

elements.literalObservation: The Small row shows an Add control.
elements.rebuildDirective: Bind to the same cart draft as all steppers and use a 44-point minimum target.

elements.literalObservation: Medium and Large rows show minus, a number, and plus in cobalt controls.
elements.rebuildDirective: Derive quantity from CartDraft; expose decrement and increment labels, limits, and disabled states.

elements.literalObservation: A realistic cold-coffee photograph occupies the lower middle of the screen.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use an aspect-preserving product asset and constrain its height so functional configuration remains visible.

elements.literalObservation: A pale rectangular field invites comments to customize the drink.
elements.rebuildDirective: Provide a persistent visible label, adequate contrast, validation, and clear single- or multiline behavior.

elements.literalObservation: A cobalt rounded control reads Add to order - Rs. 850.
elements.rebuildDirective: Derive label, item count, enabled state, and subtotal from one CartDraft and keep the button above the safe area.

elements.literalObservation: The order action includes the visible total Rs. 850.
elements.rebuildDirective: Never store independently from quantities and unit prices; test the exact subtotal invariant.

elements.literalObservation: A staff interface displays a navigation rail, order list, and selected order details.
elements.rebuildDirective: Keep as a separate desktop/tablet product with shared brand tokens but role-specific density.

elements.literalObservation: A cobalt left rail contains Dashboard, Food & Drinks, Membership, Orders, and Settings.
elements.rebuildDirective: Use persistent pointer/keyboard navigation and an explicit selected destination.

elements.literalObservation: A middle column lists multiple order summaries with one selected.
elements.rebuildDirective: Support status, time, payment, selection, keyboard movement, loading, and empty states.

elements.literalObservation: The right panel shows Order #24, status, customer, payment, items, and total.
elements.rebuildDirective: Bind to a structured Order object shared contractually with submitted consumer cart data.

elements.literalObservation: A wide blue action reads Print Customer's Invoice.
elements.rebuildDirective: Provide printing progress, success, and failure feedback and preserve keyboard access.

reconstruction.directive: Rebuild the four-screen consumer concept as a deterministic café-ordering flow that preserves the cobalt/cream illustration system while separating brand storytelling, merchandising collections, catalog taxonomy, and cart state.
layoutRules: Calibrate the 433×940 marketing panels proportionally to a 390×844 pt compact iPhone target rather than claiming a native source viewport.
Use 20–24 pt page insets, 44 pt minimum control targets, 48–52 pt primary CTA height, and 64–72 pt category rows.
Keep the landing full cobalt and other consumer screens warm cream.
Make Menu the filled primary route when repeat ordering is the main job; keep Bookings secondary unless product evidence says otherwise.
Keep onboarding optional, at most three pages, and absent after local completion.
Separate Recommended/Popular under a curated section and Food/Beverages under catalog browse.
Keep decorative illustrations and watermark outside text and hit regions.
Build product variants as adaptive rows and derive all quantities and subtotal from one CartDraft.
Anchor the add-to-order CTA above the safe area without covering scroll content.
Treat the POS as a separate staff product with shared brand tokens only.

prohibitions: Do not label the interactive landing as a passive splash screen.
Do not add a persistent consumer tab bar that is absent from the reference.
Do not mix curated collections and product taxonomy without grouping labels.
Do not implement Cool Cat's Curation before its action and destination are defined.
Do not bake product text, price, quantity, calories, or subtotal into images.
Do not maintain visible subtotal independently from cart quantities and prices.
Do not reduce custom controls to glyph-sized hit targets.
Do not use handwritten type for transactional or error copy.
Do not copy Behance device frames, shadows, or gray backdrop into the app.
Do not present missing checkout, loyalty, or order-tracking screens as observed.
Do not import mobile density into the POS or POS density into the consumer app.

consumer and staff products share tokens but not navigation/density patterns
